traits.name: Two Heads
traits.desc: The ettin has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks and on saving throws against being blinded, charmed, deafened, frightened, stunned, and knocked unconscious.

traits.name: Wakeful
traits.desc: When one of the ettin's heads is asleep, its other head is awake.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The ettin makes two attacks: one with its battleaxe and one with its morningstar.

actions.name: Battleaxe
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) slashing damage.

actions.name: Morningstar
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) piercing damage.

actions.name: Fire Breath (Recharge 5–6)
actions.desc: The ettin's right head exhales fire in a 30-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 14 Dexterity saving throw, taking 45 (10d8) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

actions.name: Cold Breath (Recharge 5–6)
actions.desc: The ettin's left head exhales an icy blast in a 30-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 14 Constitution saving throw, taking 45 (10d8) cold damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

actions.name: Gaze
actions.desc: The ettin turns its magical gaze toward one creature that it can see within 120 feet of it. That target must make a DC 14 Wisdom saving throw. Unless the target is incapacitated, it can avert its eyes to avoid the gaze and to automatically succeed on the save. If the target does so, it can't see the ettin until the start of the ettin's next turn. If the target looks at the ettin in the meantime, it must immediately make the save. If the target fails the save, it suffers one of the following effects of the ettin's choice or at random:

actions.name: Beguiling Gaze
actions.desc: The target is stunned until the start of the ettin's next turn or until the ettin is no longer within line of sight.

actions.name: Hypnotic Gaze
actions.desc: The target is charmed by the ettin until the start of the ettin's next turn. The ettin chooses how the charmed target uses its actions, reactions, and movement.

actions.name: Insanity Gaze
actions.desc: The target suffers the effect of the [[Tools/Spells/Confusion|confusion]] spell without making a saving throw. The effect lasts until the start of the ettin's next turn. The ettin doesn't need to concentrate on the spell.

traits.name: Assassinate
traits.desc: During its first turn, Andras has advantage on attack rolls against any creature that hasn't taken a turn. Any hit Andras scores against a surprised creature is a critical hit.

traits.name: Evasion
traits.desc: If Andras is subjected to an effect that allows it to make a Dexterity saving throw to take only half damage, Andras instead takes no damage if it succeeds on the saving throw, and only half damage if it fails.

traits.name: Sneak Attack (1/Turn)
traits.desc: Andras deals an extra 14 (4d6) damage when it hits a target with a weapon attack and has advantage on the attack roll, or when the target is within 5 feet of an ally of Andras that isn't incapacitated and Andras doesn't have disadvantage on the attack roll.

traits.name: Keen Hearing and Sight
traits.desc: Andras advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on hearing or sight.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Andras makes two shortsword attacks.

actions.name: Shortsword
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 11 Constitution saving throw or be cursed with wererat lycanthropy.

actions.name: Light Crossbow
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 11 Constitution saving throw or be cursed with wererat lycanthropy.

sb.name: Banrion

traits.name: Charge
traits.desc: If Banrion moves at least 20 feet straight toward a target and then hits it with a horn attack on the same turn, the target takes an extra 9 (2d8) piercing damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 15 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: Banrion has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Magic Weapons
traits.desc: Banrion's weapon attacks are magical.

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.desc:
Banrion's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 14). Banrion can innately cast the following spells, requiring no components:

- **At Will:** [[Tools/Spells/Detect Evil And Good|detect evil and good]], [[Tools/Spells/Druidcraft|druidcraft]], [[Tools/Spells/Pass Without Trace|pass without trace]]
- **1/Day Each:** [[Tools/Spells/Calm Emotions|calm emotions]], [[Tools/Spells/Dispel Evil And Good|dispel evil and good]], [[Tools/Spells/Entangle|entangle]]

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Banrion makes two attacks: one with its hooves and one with its horn.

actions.name: Hooves
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Horn
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) piercing damage.

actions.name: Healing Touch (3/Day)
actions.desc: Banrion touches another creature with its horn. The target magically regains 11 (2d8 + 2) hit points. In addition, the touch removes all diseases and neutralizes all poisons afflicting the target.

actions.name: Teleport (1/Day)
actions.desc: Banrion magically teleports itself and up to three willing creatures it can see within 5 feet of it, along with any equipment they are wearing or carrying, to a location Banrion is familiar with, up to 1 mile away.

legendary_actions.name: Hooves
legendary_actions.desc: Banrion makes one attack with its hooves.

legendary_actions.name: Shimmering Shield (Costs 2 Actions)
legendary_actions.desc: Banrion creates a shimmering, magical field around itself or another creature it can see within 60 feet of it. The target gains a +2 bonus to AC until the end of Banrion's next turn.

sb.legendary_description: Legendary action uses: 3. One can be taken immediately after another creature's turn, and all uses come back at the start of this creature's turn.

traits.name: Rust Monster Cloak
traits.desc: Any nonmagical weapon made of metal that hits Barbatos corrodes. After dealing damage, the weapon takes a permanent and cumulative -1 penalty to damage rolls. If its penalty drops to -5, the weapon is destroyed. Nonmagical ammunition made of metal that hits Barbatos is destroyed after dealing damage.

traits.name: Heart of the Troll
traits.desc: Barbatos regains 10 hit points at the start of his turn. If Barbatos takes acid or fire damage, this trait doesn't function at the start of Barbatos's next turn. Barbatos dies only if he starts his turn with 0 hit points and doesn't regenerate.

traits.name: Spellcasting
traits.desc:
Barbatos is a 6th-level spellcaster. His spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save DC 13, +5 to hit with spell attacks). He has the following ranger spells prepared:

- **1st level (4 slots):** [[Tools/Spells/Ensnaring Strike|ensnaring strike]], [[Tools/Spells/Hail Of Thorns|hail of thorns]], [[Tools/Spells/Hunter'S Mark|hunter's mark]]
- **2nd level (2 slots):** [[Tools/Spells/Locate Animals Or Plants|locate animals or plants]]

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Barbatos makes two bone shortsword attacks.

actions.name: Bone Shortsword
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage.

actions.name: Light Crossbow
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned for 1 hour. If the saving throw fails by 5 or more, the target is also unconscious. The target regains consciousness if it takes damage or if another creature takes an action to shake it.

actions.name: Cloak Sweep
actions.desc: Barbatos corrodes a nonmagical ferrous metal object he can see within 5 feet of himself. If the object isn't being worn or carried, the touch destroys a 1-foot cube of it. If the object is being worn or carried by a creature, the creature can make a DC 12 Dexterity saving throw to avoid Barbatos's touch. If the object touched is either metal armor or a metal shield being worn or carried, it takes a permanent and cumulative 1 penalty to the AC it offers. Armor reduced to an AC of 10 or a shield that drops to a +0 bonus is destroyed. If the object touched is a held metal weapon, it rusts as described in Barbatos's Rust Monster Cloak trait.

traits.name: Detect Sentience
traits.desc: The brain in iron can sense the presence and location of any creature within 300 feet of it that has an Intelligence of 3 or higher, regardless of interposing barriers, unless the creature is protected by a [[Tools/Spells/Mind Blank|mind blank]] spell.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: The brain in iron has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting (Psionics)
traits.desc:
The brain in iron's innate spellcasting ability is Intelligence (spell save DC 15). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no components:

- **At Will:** [[Tools/Spells/Detect Thoughts|detect thoughts]], [[Tools/Spells/Mage Hand|mage hand]], [[Tools/Spells/Zone Of Truth|zone of truth]]
- **3/Day Each:** [[Tools/Spells/Charm Person|charm person]], [[Tools/Spells/Command|command]], [[Tools/Spells/Hold Person|hold person]]
- **1/Day Each:** [[Tools/Spells/Compulsion|compulsion]], [[Tools/Spells/Hold Monster|hold monster]], [[Tools/Spells/Sleep|sleep]] (cast at 3rd level), [[Tools/Spells/Tasha'S Hideous Laughter|Tasha's hideous laughter]]

actions.name: Mind Blast (Recharge 5–6)
actions.desc: The brain in iron magically emits psychic energy in a 60-foot cone. Each creature in that area must succeed on a DC 15 Intelligence saving throw or take 13 (2d8 + 4) psychic damage and be stunned for 1 minute. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

traits.name: Dark Devotion
traits.desc: The worker has advantage on saving throws against being charmed or frightened.

traits.name: Dwarven Resilience
traits.desc: The dwarven worker has advantage on saving throws against poison, and has resistance against poison damage.

actions.name: Pick or Hammer
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 4 (1d6 + 1) bludgeoning or piercing damage.

traits.name: Petrifying Gaze
traits.desc: When a creature that can see the medusa's eyes starts its turn within 30 feet of the medusa, the medusa can force it to make a DC 14 Constitution saving throw if the medusa isn't incapacitated and can see the creature. If the saving throw fails by 5 or more, the creature is instantly petrified. Otherwise, a creature that fails the save begins to turn to metal, wood, or porcelain (the medusa's choice) and is restrained. The restrained creature must repeat the saving throw at the end of its next turn, becoming petrified on a failure or ending the effect on a success. The petrification lasts until the creature is freed by the [[Tools/Spells/Greater Restoration|greater restoration]] spell or other magic. Unless surprised, a creature can avert its eyes to avoid the saving throw at the start of its turn. If the creature does so, it can't see the medusa until the start of its next turn, when it can avert its eyes again. If the creature looks at the medusa in the meantime, it must immediately make the save. If the medusa sees itself reflected on a polished surface within 30 feet of it and in an area of bright light, the medusa is, due to its curse, affected by its own gaze.

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.desc:
The medusa's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 13). The medusa can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:

- **Cantrips (at will):** [[Tools/Spells/Light|light]]

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The medusa makes either three melee attacks—one with its snake hair and two with its shortsword—or two ranged attacks with its longbow.

actions.name: Snake Hair
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage plus 14 (4d6) poison damage.

actions.name: Shortsword
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage.

actions.name: Longbow
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) poison damage.

traits.name: False Appearance
traits.desc: While Grandfather Oak remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from a normal tree.

traits.name: Siege Monster
traits.desc: Grandfather Oak deals double damage to objects and structures.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Grandfather Oak makes two slam attacks.

actions.name: Slam
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 16 (3d6 + 6) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Rock
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, range 60/180 ft., one target. Hit: 28 (4d10 + 6) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Animate Trees (1/Day)
actions.desc: Grandfather Oak magically animates one or two trees it can see within 60 feet of it. These trees have the same statistics as a treant, except they have Intelligence and Charisma scores of 1, they can't speak, and they have only the Slam action option. An animated tree acts as an ally of Grandfather Oak. The tree remains animate for 1 day or until it dies; until Grandfather Oak dies or is more than 120 feet from the tree; or until Grandfather Oak takes a bonus action to turn it back into an inanimate tree. The tree then takes root if possible.

actions.name: Pacifying Spores (3/Day)
actions.desc: Grandfather Oak ejects spores at one creature it can see within 5 feet of it. The target must succeed on a DC 17 Constitution saving throw or be stunned for 1 minute. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

sb.name: Lynx Creatlach
sb.condition_immunities: charmed, exhaustion, frightened, paralyzed, poisoned, stunned

traits.name: Special Equipment
traits.desc: Lynx's crystal eye is a magically shrunken crystal ball of true seeing. One of her teeth is a refashioned ring of mind shielding, while another has been magicked to place her under a permanent [[Tools/Spells/Nystul'S Magic Aura|Nystul's magic aura]] spell, concealing the magic of these items and hiding her true nature from magic or features that can detect undead.

traits.name: Aversion of Fire
traits.desc: If Lynx takes fire damage, she has disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks until the end of her next turn.

traits.name: Immutable Form
traits.desc: Lynx is immune to any spell or effect that would alter her form.

traits.name: Lightning Absorption
traits.desc: Whenever Lynx is subjected to lightning damage, she takes no damage and instead regains a number of hit points equal to the lightning damage dealt.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: Lynx has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Regeneration
traits.desc: Lynx regains 10 hit points at the start of her turn. If she takes fire or radiant damage, this trait doesn't function at the start of her next turn. Lynx's body is destroyed only if she starts her turn with 0 hit points and doesn't regenerate.

traits.name: Turn Immunity
traits.desc: Lynx is immune to effects that turn undead.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Lynx makes two shortsword attacks.

actions.name: Shortsword
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) piercing damage.

traits.name: Special Equipment
traits.desc: Moghadam wields Ruinblade (see appendix C).

traits.name: Artificial Mind
traits.desc: Moghadam can manifest an artificial mind as a floating spectral image of a demilich's jeweled skull. Moghadam can communicate telepathically with this mind, send it up to 300 feet away from him, and see and hear through it.

traits.name: Infoportation (1/Day)
traits.desc: Moghadam can teleport himself into an unoccupied space next to his artificial mind.

traits.name: Spellcasting
traits.desc:
Moghadam is an 18th-level spellcaster. His spellcasting ability is Intelligence (spell save DC 16, +8 to hit with spell attacks). He has the following artificer spells prepared:

- **Cantrips (at will):** [[Tools/Spells/Dancing Lights|dancing lights]], [[Tools/Spells/Light|light]], [[Tools/Spells/Message|message]], [[Tools/Spells/Shocking Grasp|shocking grasp]]
- **1st level (4 slots):** [[Tools/Spells/Comprehend Languages|comprehend languages]], [[Tools/Spells/Cure Wounds|cure wounds]], [[Tools/Spells/Grease|grease]], [[Tools/Spells/Identify|identify]]
- **2nd level (3 slots):** [[Tools/Spells/Detect Thoughts|detect thoughts]], [[Tools/Spells/Invisibility|invisibility]], [[Tools/Spells/Heat Metal|heat metal]]
- **3rd level (3 slots):** [[Tools/Spells/Dispel Magic|dispel magic]], [[Tools/Spells/Flame Arrows|flame arrows]], [[Tools/Spells/Hypnotic Pattern|hypnotic pattern]]
- **4th level (3 slots):** [[Tools/Spells/Fabricate|fabricate]], [[Tools/Spells/Stone Shape|stone shape]], [[Tools/Spells/Stoneskin|stoneskin]]
- **5th level (1 slot):** [[Tools/Spells/Creation|creation]]

actions.name: Ruinblade
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (2d6 + 2) slashing damage.

actions.name: Blight (1/Day)
actions.desc: While wielding Ruinblade, Moghadam can cast the [[Tools/Spells/Blight|blight]] spell (DC 15).

actions.name: Disintegrate (1/7 Days)
actions.desc: While wielding Ruinblade, Moghadam can cast the [[Tools/Spells/Disintegrate|disintegrate]] spell against any nonmagical object or creation of magical force.

actions.name: Information Overload (Recharge 5–6)
actions.desc: Moghadam overloads the thoughts of one creature within 5 feet of either himself or his artificial mind. The target must succeed on a DC 16 Intelligence saving throw or take 22 (4d8 + 4) psychic damage, and the next attack roll made against the target before the end of Moghadam's next turn has advantage.

traits.name: Limited Telepathy
traits.desc: The otyugh can magically transmit simple messages and images to any creature within 120 feet of it that can understand a language. This form of telepathy doesn't allow the receiving creature to telepathically respond.

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting (Psionics)
traits.desc:
The neo-otyugh's innate spellcasting ability is Intelligence (spell save DC 12). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no components:

- **At Will:** [[Tools/Spells/Detect Thoughts|detect thoughts]]
- **1/Day Each:** [[Tools/Spells/Command|command]], [[Tools/Spells/Hold Person|hold person]]

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The neo-otyugh makes three attacks: one with its bite and two with its tentacles.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 16 (2d10 + 5) piercing damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 17 Constitution saving throw against disease or become poisoned until the disease is cured. Every 24 hours that elapse, the target must repeat the saving throw, reducing its hit point maximum by 5 (1d10) on a failure. The disease is cured on a success. The target dies if the disease reduces its hit point maximum to 0. This reduction to the target's hit point maximum lasts until the disease is cured.

actions.name: Tentacle
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (1d10 + 5) bludgeoning damage. If the target is Large or smaller, it is grappled (escape DC 16) and restrained until the grapple ends. The neo-otyugh has two tentacles, each of which can grapple one target.

actions.name: Tentacle Slam
actions.desc: The neo-otyugh slams creatures grappled by it into each other or a solid surface. Each creature must succeed on a DC 16 Constitution saving throw or take 15 (3d6 + 5) bludgeoning damage and be stunned until the end of the neo-otyugh's next turn. On a successful save, the target takes half the bludgeoning damage and isn't stunned.

traits.name: Earth Walk
traits.desc: Seodra can move across difficult terrain made of earth or stone without expending extra movement.

traits.name: Treasure Sense
traits.desc: Seodra can pinpoint, by scent, the location of precious metals and stones, such as coins and gems, within 60 feet of her.

actions.name: Rapier
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d8 + 1) piercing damage.

reactions.name: Parry
reactions.desc: Seodra adds 2 to its AC against one melee attack that would hit it. To do so, Seodra must see the attacker and be wielding a melee weapon.

traits.name: Special Equipment
traits.desc: Sir Ursas wears a ring of mind shielding and plate armor of fire resistance.

traits.name: Brave
traits.desc: Sir Ursas has advantage on saving throws against being frightened.

traits.name: Brute
traits.desc: A melee weapon deals one extra die of its damage when Sir Ursas hits with it (included in his attack).

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Sir Ursas makes three melee attacks or two ranged attacks.

actions.name: Claw
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) slashing damage.

actions.name: Spear
actions.desc: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft. and range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) piercing damage, or 13 (2d8 + 4) piercing damage if used with two hands to make a melee attack.

actions.name: Shield Bash
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (2d4 + 4) bludgeoning damage, and if the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it must succeed on a DC 15 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

reactions.name: Parry
reactions.desc: Sir Ursas adds 3 to his AC against one melee attack that would hit him. To do so, he must see the attacker and be wielding a melee weapon.

sb.name: Skeletal Giant Owl
sb.languages: Giant Owl, understands Common, Elvish, and Sylvan but can't speak them

traits.name: Flyby
traits.desc: The owl doesn't provoke opportunity attacks when it flies out of an enemy's reach.

traits.name: Keen Hearing and Sight
traits.desc: The owl has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on hearing or sight.

actions.name: Talons
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (2d6 + 1) slashing damage.

traits.name: Keen Sight and Smell
traits.desc: The owlbear has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight or smell.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The owlbear makes two attacks: one with its beak and one with its claws.

actions.name: Beak
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 10 (1d10 + 5) piercing damage.

actions.name: Claws
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) slashing damage.

traits.name: Keen Smell
traits.desc: The bear has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The bear makes two attacks: one with its bite and one with its claws.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (1d8 + 5) piercing damage.

actions.name: Claws
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d6 + 5) slashing damage.

traits.name: Two Heads
traits.desc: The two-headed owlbear has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks and on saving throws against being blinded, charmed, deafened, frightened, stunned, and knocked unconscious.

traits.name: Wakeful
traits.desc: When one of the owlbear's heads is asleep, its other head is awake.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The two-headed owlbear makes three attacks: two with its beaks and one with its claws.

actions.name: Beak
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (1d10 + 5) piercing damage.

actions.name: Claws
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) slashing damage.

traits.name: Whispering Aura
traits.desc: At the start of each of Stolos's turns, each creature of its choice within 5 feet of it must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or take 10 (3d6) psychic damage, provided that Stolos isn't incapacitated.

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.desc:
Stolos's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma. It can innately cast the following spells (spell save DC 15), requiring no material components:

- **At Will:** [[Tools/Spells/Detect Magic|detect magic]], [[Tools/Spells/Jump|jump]], [[Tools/Spells/Levitate|levitate]], [[Tools/Spells/Mage Armor|mage armor]] (self only), [[Tools/Spells/Speak With Dead|speak with dead]]
- **1/Day Each:** [[Tools/Spells/Arcane Gate|arcane gate]], [[Tools/Spells/True Seeing|true seeing]]

traits.name: Spellcasting
traits.desc:
Stolos is a 14th-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 15, +7 to hit with spell attacks). It regains its expended spell slots when it finishes a short or long rest. It knows the following warlock spells:

- **Cantrips (at will):** [[Tools/Spells/Chill Touch|chill touch]], [[Tools/Spells/Eldritch Blast|eldritch blast]], [[Tools/Spells/Guidance|guidance]], [[Tools/Spells/Mage Hand|mage hand]], [[Tools/Spells/Minor Illusion|minor illusion]], [[Tools/Spells/Prestidigitation|prestidigitation]], [[Tools/Spells/Shocking Grasp|shocking grasp]]
- **1st–5th level (3 5th-level slots):** [[Tools/Spells/Armor Of Agathys|armor of Agathys]], [[Tools/Spells/Arms Of Hadar|arms of Hadar]], [[Tools/Spells/Crown Of Madness|crown of madness]], [[Tools/Spells/Clairvoyance|clairvoyance]], [[Tools/Spells/Contact Other Plane|contact other plane]], [[Tools/Spells/Detect Thoughts|detect thoughts]], [[Tools/Spells/Dimension Door|dimension door]], [[Tools/Spells/Dissonant Whispers|dissonant whispers]], [[Tools/Spells/Dominate Beast|dominate beast]], [[Tools/Spells/Telekinesis|telekinesis]], [[Tools/Spells/Vampiric Touch|vampiric touch]]

actions.name: Talons
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (2d6 + 1) slashing damage.

sb.name: Tarnhem
sb.damage_resistances: cold, lightning; bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks

traits.name: Death Throes
traits.desc: When Tarnhem dies, it explodes, and each creature within 30 feet of it must make a DC 20 Dexterity saving throw, taking 70 (20d6) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. The explosion ignites flammable objects in that area that aren't being worn or carried, and it destroys Tarnhem's weapons.

traits.name: Fire Aura
traits.desc: At the start of each of Tarnhem's turns, each creature within 5 feet of it takes 10 (3d6) fire damage, and flammable objects in the aura that aren't being worn or carried ignite. A creature that touches Tarnhem or hits it with a melee attack while within 5 feet of it takes 10 (3d6) fire damage.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: Tarnhem has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Magic Weapons
traits.desc: Tarnhem's weapon attacks are magical.

actions.name: Fist of Retribution
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +14 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d4 + 8) bludgeoning damage plus 7 (2d6) fire damage.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Tarnhem makes two attacks: one with its longsword and one with its whip.

actions.name: Longsword
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +14 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 21 (3d8 + 8) slashing damage plus 13 (3d8) lightning damage. If Tarnhem scores a critical hit, it rolls damage dice three times, instead of twice.

actions.name: Whip
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +14 to hit, reach 30 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (2d6 + 8) slashing damage plus 10 (3d6) fire damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 20 Strength saving throw or be pulled up to 25 feet toward Tarnhem.

actions.name: Teleport
actions.desc: Tarnhem magically teleports, along with any equipment it is wearing or carrying, up to 120 feet to an unoccupied space it can see.

traits.name: Special Equipment
traits.desc: Thessalar wields a +1 dagger coated with thessaltoxin poison (see appendix C).

traits.name: Alchemical Homunculus
traits.desc: Thessalar is accompanied by his Thessalar's homunculus. If the [[Tools/Spells/Mending|mending]] spell is cast on it, the homunculus regains 2d6 hit points.

traits.name: Healing Toxicity
traits.desc: Any magic item that restores hit points and can be applied to a piercing or slashing weapon (a potion, an ointment, and so forth) causes a hit with that weapon to deal extra damage to Thessalar equal to the amount the item would normally heal.

traits.name: Greater Restoration (1/Day)
traits.desc: Thessalar can cast [[Tools/Spells/Greater Restoration|greater restoration]] if he has access to alchemical supplies.

traits.name: Spellcasting
traits.desc:
Thessalar is an 18th-level spellcaster. His spellcasting ability is Intelligence (spell save DC 16, +8 to hit with spell attacks). He has the following artificer spells prepared:

- **Cantrips (at will):** [[Tools/Spells/Light|light]], [[Tools/Spells/Mending|mending]], [[Tools/Spells/Message|message]], [[Tools/Spells/Shocking Grasp|shocking grasp]]
- **1st level (4 slots):** [[Tools/Spells/Alarm|alarm]], [[Tools/Spells/Cure Wounds|cure wounds]], [[Tools/Spells/Identify|identify]], [[Tools/Spells/Ray Of Sickness|ray of sickness]]
- **2nd level (3 slots):** [[Tools/Spells/Invisibility|invisibility]], [[Tools/Spells/Melf'S Acid Arrow|Melf's acid arrow]], [[Tools/Spells/Web|web]]
- **3rd level (3 slots):** [[Tools/Spells/Dispel Magic|dispel magic]], [[Tools/Spells/Haste|haste]], [[Tools/Spells/Stinking Cloud|stinking cloud]]
- **4th level (3 slots):** [[Tools/Spells/Blight|blight]], [[Tools/Spells/Mordenkainen'S Faithful Hound|Mordenkainen's faithful hound]], [[Tools/Spells/Otiluke'S Resilient Sphere|Otiluke's resilient sphere]]
- **5th level (1 slot):** [[Tools/Spells/Cloudkill|cloudkill]]

actions.name: Dagger
actions.desc: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 3 (1d4 + 1) piercing damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the target is affected as if by the [[Tools/Spells/Polymorph|polymorph]] spell, transforming into a random beast or a creature it has seen within the last 24 hours (as chosen by the DM). This effect lasts until the target finishes a long rest.

sb.name: Thessalar's Homunculus
sb.languages: understands the languages of its creator but can't speak

traits.name: Telepathic Bond
traits.desc: While the homunculus is on the same plane of existence as its master, it can magically convey what it senses to its master, and the two can communicate telepathically.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 1 piercing damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 10 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned for 1 minute. If the saving throw fails by 5 or more, the target is instead poisoned for 5 (1d10) minutes and unconscious while poisoned in this way.

actions.name: Acidic Spittle
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, range 30 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) acid damage.

sb.name: Thessalheart Construct
sb.languages: understands the languages of its creator but can't speak

traits.name: Telepathic Bond
traits.desc: While the construct is on the same plane of existence as its master, it can magically convey what it senses to its master, and the two can communicate telepathically.

actions.name: Claws
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 1 slashing damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 10 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned for 1 minute. If the saving throw fails by 5 or more, the target is instead poisoned for 5 (1d10) minutes and unconscious while poisoned in this way.

sb.name: Thessalkraken
sb.damage_immunities: acid; bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks
sb.languages: understands Abyssal, Celestial, Infernal, and Primordial but can't speak, telepathy 120 ft.

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.desc: The thessalkraken can breathe air and water.

traits.name: Freedom of Movement
traits.desc: The thessalkraken ignores difficult terrain, and magical effects can't reduce its speed or cause it to be restrained. It can spend 5 feet of movement to escape from nonmagical restraints or being grappled.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The thessalkraken makes one bite attack and two tentacle attacks. It can replace each tentacle attack with one use of Fling.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +12 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 20 (3d8 + 7) piercing damage plus 5 (1d10) acid damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature grappled by the thessalkraken, that creature is swallowed, and the grapple ends. While swallowed, the creature is blinded and restrained, it has total cover against attacks and other effects outside the thessalkraken, and it takes 21 (6d6) acid damage at the start of each of the thessalkraken's turns. If the thessalkraken takes 35 damage or more on a single turn from a creature inside it, it must succeed on a DC 23 Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate all swallowed creatures, which fall prone in a space within 10 feet of the thessalkraken. If the thessalkraken dies, a swallowed creature is no longer restrained by it and can escape from the corpse using 10 feet of movement, exiting prone.

actions.name: Tentacle
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +12 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. Hit: 17 (3d6 + 7) slashing damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 16). Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained. The thessalkraken has ten tentacles, each of which can grapple one target.

actions.name: Fling
actions.desc: One Medium or smaller object held or creature grappled by the thessalkraken is thrown up to 40 feet in a random direction and knocked prone. If a thrown target strikes a solid surface, the target takes 3 (1d6) bludgeoning damage for every 10 feet it was thrown. If the target is thrown at another creature, that creature must succeed on a DC 16 Dexterity saving throw or take the same damage and be knocked prone.

actions.name: Acid Saliva (Recharge 5–6)
actions.desc: The thessalkraken spits a glob of acid at a point it can see within 60 feet of it. Each creature within 10 feet of that point must make a DC 18 Dexterity saving throw, taking 22 (4d10) acid damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

legendary_actions.name: Tentacle Attack
legendary_actions.desc: The thessalkraken makes one tentacle attack.

legendary_actions.name: Ink Cloud (Costs 3 Actions)
legendary_actions.desc: While underwater, the thessalkraken expels an ink cloud in a 60-foot radius. The cloud spreads around corners, and that area is heavily obscured to creatures other than the thessalkraken. Each creature other than the thessalkraken that ends its turn there must succeed on a DC 18 Constitution saving throw, taking 16 (3d10) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. A strong current disperses the cloud, which otherwise disappears at the end of the thessalkraken's next turn.

sb.legendary_description: Legendary action uses: 3. One can be taken immediately after another creature's turn, and all uses come back at the start of this creature's turn.

traits.name: Dark Devotion
traits.desc: The muralist has advantage on saving throws against being charmed or frightened.

actions.name: Scimitar
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 4 (1d6 + 1) slashing damage.

traits.name: Hold Breath
traits.desc: The two-headed crocodile can hold its breath for 15 minutes.

traits.name: Two Heads
traits.desc: The two-headed crocodile has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks and on saving throws against being blinded, charmed, deafened, frightened, stunned, and knocked unconscious.

traits.name: Wakeful
traits.desc: When one of the crocodile's heads is asleep, its other head is awake.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The two-headed crocodile makes two attacks with its bite.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d10 + 2) piercing damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 12). Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained, and that head of the crocodile can't bite another target.

traits.name: Two Heads
traits.desc: The two-headed owlbear has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks and on saving throws against being blinded, charmed, deafened, frightened, stunned, and knocked unconscious.

traits.name: Wakeful
traits.desc: When one of the owlbear's heads is asleep, its other head is awake.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The two-headed owlbear makes three attacks: two with its beaks and one with its claws.

actions.name: Beak
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (1d10 + 5) piercing damage.

actions.name: Claws
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) slashing damage.
